NONE: › red or gold, as if burning

example: 整個村子都陷入一片火海中。

時值秋天，樹林絢爛似火。

NONE: › having enough money to pay what you owe
有償債能力的；經濟上周轉自如的

example: She spent seven days afloat on a raft.
她在一隻木筏上漂流了七天。
He managed to keep/stay afloat by holding on to the side of the boat.
他抓住了船舷才使自己沒有沉到水底。
Many small businesses are struggling to stay/keep afloat.
許多小企業只能勉強維持經營。

NONE: 激動不安的；緊張興奮的

example: I'm all aflutter about meeting him after so long.
久別後將再次見到他，我激動不已。
